items.heading: Mui Borok
details: Key ingredients: mixed vegetables, bamboo shoot, dried fish, herbs
Boil a mix of seasonal vegetables with bamboo shoot.
Add dried fish and fresh herbs for a distinct aroma.
Simmer until the vegetables are tender and well flavored.
Serve hot with steamed rice.

items.heading: Vegetable Pulao
details: Ingredients: rice, mixed vegetables, onion, whole spices.
Rinse rice.
Fry onion and spices, add vegetables and rice, then simmer with water until fluffy.

items.heading: Jeera Rice
details: Ingredients: rice, cumin, ghee, salt.
Rinse rice.
Bloom cumin in ghee, add rice and water, then simmer until tender.

items.heading: Plain Dal
details: Ingredients: lentils, turmeric, cumin, garlic.
Boil lentils with turmeric until soft.
Fry cumin and garlic and stir into the dal.

items.heading: Dal Tadka
details: Ingredients: lentils, onion, tomato, cumin, garlic.
Cook lentils until soft.
Fry onion, tomato, cumin and garlic; combine and simmer briefly.

items.heading: Aloo Gobi
details: Ingredients: potato, cauliflower, tomato, turmeric, cumin.
Fry cumin, add potato and cauliflower with spices, cover and cook until tender.

items.heading: Aloo Matar
details: Ingredients: potato, peas, tomato, onion, ginger.
Cook onion, ginger and tomato with spices.
Add potato, peas and water; simmer until soft.

items.heading: Palak Paneer
details: Ingredients: spinach, paneer, onion, garlic, spices.
Blanch and puree spinach.
Cook onion and garlic with spices, add spinach and paneer; simmer.

items.heading: Paneer Bhurji
details: Ingredients: paneer, onion, tomato, green chilli.
Saute onion and tomato with chilli and spices; crumble in paneer and cook briefly.

items.heading: Vegetable Khichdi
details: Ingredients: rice, moong dal, vegetables, turmeric.
Wash rice and dal.
Add vegetables, turmeric and water; cook until soft.

items.heading: Curd Rice
details: Ingredients: rice, curd, mustard seeds, curry leaves.
Cool cooked rice and mix with curd.
Temper mustard and curry leaves in oil and stir in.

items.heading: Chapati
details: Ingredients: whole wheat flour, water, salt.
Knead flour with water, rest, roll thin and cook both sides on a hot griddle.

items.heading: Poori
details: Ingredients: whole wheat flour, water, oil.
Knead a firm dough, roll small discs and deep fry until puffed and golden.

items.heading: Paratha
details: Ingredients: whole wheat flour, oil or ghee, water.
Knead flour and water, roll with a little fat, and cook on a griddle until browned.

items.heading: Aloo Paratha
details: Ingredients: whole wheat flour, potato, chilli, spices.
Stuff dough with spiced mashed potato; roll gently and cook with oil on a griddle.

items.heading: Besan Chilla
details: Ingredients: gram flour, onion, chilli, water.
Whisk flour with water, onion and chilli; spread on a hot pan and cook both sides.

items.heading: Vegetable Upma
details: Ingredients: semolina, onion, vegetables, mustard seeds.
Toast semolina.
Temper mustard, onion and vegetables; add water and stir in semolina until thick.

items.heading: Poha
details: Ingredients: flattened rice, onion, peanuts, turmeric.
Rinse poha.
Fry peanuts, onion and turmeric, then toss with poha until warmed through.

items.heading: Vegetable Pakora
details: Ingredients: gram flour, mixed vegetables, spices, oil.
Coat sliced vegetables in seasoned gram flour batter and fry until crisp.

items.heading: Aloo Tikki
details: Ingredients: potato, peas, cumin, chilli.
Mash cooked potatoes with peas and spices, form patties and shallow fry until crisp.

items.heading: Suji Halwa
details: Ingredients: semolina, ghee, sugar, water.
Toast semolina in ghee, add hot sweetened water and stir until thick.

items.heading: Chuak
details: Key ingredients: fermented rice, local herbs
Cook rice until well done, then cool slightly.
Mix with traditional herbs used for fermentation.
Allow the mixture to ferment for a day or two in a clean container.
Strain and serve as a mildly tangy traditional rice drink.
